project.name: KHKD - San La Gan
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — san la gan tu goi ca song
project.story: The Vietnamese liver fluke (Clonorchis sinensis / Opisthorchis) infects people who eat raw or undercooked freshwater fish dishes like goi ca. Encysted larvae in the fish muscle survive, travel up the bile ducts into the liver, attach, and live there for 20-30 years, silently damaging the liver. Vietnam has one of the highest infection rates in the world.
